name: Sarah Elizabeth Chamberlain
bioAdditions: FamilySearch (profile 'Sarah Scott') gives her birth at Shutesbury, Mass., on 12 Nov 1741 from a Massachusetts births index entry for Sarah Chamberlain, and her death on 8 Dec 1831 at Albany, NY, with a Find a Grave index entry as 'Sarah Chamberlain Scott'; a Vermont vital record for her son Jonathan Scott names her (S1). As with her husband Matthew, her place in Johnny's ancestry depends on the undocumented Daniel Scott link.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Descent to Stephen J. Scott undocumented.
